methodology_rows: Loads WikiText, tokenises, masks 15% under a span or independent policy, and writes a manifested batch file with a hash
4-layer Transformer, width 256, shared by every condition so only the objective changes
MLM control, latent recipes A and B, VICReg and Barlow auxiliaries, and a no-teacher control
AdamW with an annealed schedule, EMA teacher, resumable checkpoints and provenance in every run
Effective rank, frozen linear probe on AG News, and the ambiguity analysis
evidence_bullets: • Data module: 600 WikiText-103 records became 75 batches — 39,388 tokens, 5,767 masked targets, hashed and manifested before training.
• Training module: latent recipe A on CPU, loss 2.018 → 1.086 over 75 updates, with checkpoint, metrics and metadata written.
• Same data, same schedule, MLM control — the only difference is what the model is asked to predict.
• 64 automated tests pass, and every run records its commit hash and the tokens it actually saw.
demo_bullets: Dashboard rebuilt from results/person1/*.json: six conditions, two budgets, geometry, ambiguity.
Walkthrough: build batches, train 40 updates, probe, geometry - all from committed scripts.
Repository: github.com/dakshadev/7th-sem (link below and on the contents slide).
Demo recording: to be captured before the review and stored in docs/assets - not claimed as done here.
outline: Introduction — why latent targets, and why small budgets change the answer
